n: Basilica of Our Lady of the Assumption, Secunderabad
desc: Basilica of Our Lady of the Assumption is a minor basilica located in Secunderabad, India. The decree designating it as a basilica was issued on 7 November 2008. The church is located on Sarojini Naidu Road in Secunderabad.
fact: Mary's Church was completed in 1850 · In 1886, it ceased to be a cathedral · It owes its early history to Father Daniel Murphy along with Bishop Carew · This church was formerly called the Cathedral of the Archdiocese of Hyderabad

n: Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health
desc: The Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, also known as Sanctuary of Our Lady of Velankanni, is a Christian shrine located at the town of Velankanni, Tamil Nadu, India. The shrine is dedicated to the Blessed Virgin Mary.
